{"consolidated_memory":"**Conflict loops in mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS**

**Incident 1: 2026-01-23 - Cache invalidation issue**
- File: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
- Environment: Staging read replica only
- Repro: Edit the same note on two devices offline
- Root cause: Cache entry never invalidated on write
- Signal: Two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- Outcome: 57 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- Fix: Invalidated the cache entry inside the write transaction
- PR: #5459
- Branch: fix/conflict-loop-1

**Incident 2: 2026-08-18 - Clock skew issue**
- File: mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift (mobile sync side)
- Trigger: Occurred after the client had already retried once
- Repro: Edit the same note on two devices offline
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Signal: Two clients rewriting each other on every pass
- Outcome: Job finished in 11 minutes instead of 6 hours
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR: #8047
- Branch: fix/conflict-loop-2

Both incidents occurred in the same corner of mobile/ios/SyncEngine.swift, with prior context from earlier conflict loop work carrying over."}
